description: Read a Bluesky list or starter pack with list, or discover one actor’s public lists or starter packs with actor and kind. Direct reads return metadata and one membership page. To read posts, pass a list URI or a starter pack feedUri to bsky_get_feed.

actor.description: Handle, @handle, DID, or bsky.app profile URL. Use with kind to discover collections.

cursor.description: Nonempty opaque cursor from a previous page of the same list or the same actor and kind.

kind.description: Collection to discover for actor. Required with actor. Omit with list.

limit.description: Maximum members or discovery results to return. Default 25. Values above 100 are clamped unless read-limit clamping is disabled.

list.description: List or starter pack AT-URI or bsky.app page. Use for a direct membership read.

name: bsky_get_list

cursor.description: Opaque cursor as supplied by Bluesky. Reuse a nonempty value with the same list or actor and kind, even after an empty page. An empty or absent cursor ends pagination.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_mode`: The arguments do not select exactly one collection mode. `list_not_found`: The requested list does not exist or its owner handle does not resolve. `starter_pack_not_found`: The requested starter pack does not exist or its owner handle does not resolve. `actor_not_found`: Bluesky could not find the actor’s profile. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

list.description: Requested list metadata, or the starter pack’s backing list metadata.

displayName.description: Display name supplied by the account.

description.description: Description supplied by the list creator.

listItemCount.description: Bluesky’s reported member count across the list.

name.description: Name supplied by the list creator.

purpose.description: List purpose as reported by Bluesky, including future values.

uri.description: List AT-URI. Use with bsky_get_list or bsky_get_feed.

lists.description: Lists visible on this discovery page.

items.description: Metadata for a Bluesky graph list.

displayName.description: Display name supplied by the account.

description.description: Description supplied by the list creator.

listItemCount.description: Bluesky’s reported member count across the list.

name.description: Name supplied by the list creator.

purpose.description: List purpose as reported by Bluesky, including future values.

uri.description: List AT-URI. Use with bsky_get_list or bsky_get_feed.

members.description: Membership records on this page. Absent if membership is unavailable or this is a discovery page.

items.description: One list membership record and its account.

subject.description: Account in the list. Use its DID or handle with bsky_get_profile.

displayName.description: Display name supplied by the account.

notice.description: Limit clamp or reason starter pack membership is unavailable.

shown.description: Number of members or discovery results on this page.

creator.description: Account that created the starter pack.

displayName.description: Display name supplied by the account.

description.description: Description supplied by the starter pack creator.

feeds.description: Feed references supplied for the starter pack.

items.description: A feed reference supplied for the starter pack.

feedUri.description: Generator AT-URI to pass to bsky_get_feed.

joinedAllTimeCount.description: All-time joins as reported by Bluesky.

joinedWeekCount.description: Joins in the past week as reported by Bluesky.

listUri.description: AT-URI of the backing list. Use with bsky_get_list or bsky_get_feed.

name.description: Name supplied by the starter pack creator.

uri.description: Starter pack AT-URI. Use with bsky_get_list.

starterPacks.description: Starter packs visible on this discovery page.

items.description: Metadata for a Bluesky starter pack.

creator.description: Account that created the starter pack.

displayName.description: Display name supplied by the account.

description.description: Description supplied by the starter pack creator.

feeds.description: Feed references supplied for the starter pack.

items.description: A feed reference supplied for the starter pack.

feedUri.description: Generator AT-URI to pass to bsky_get_feed.

joinedAllTimeCount.description: All-time joins as reported by Bluesky.

joinedWeekCount.description: Joins in the past week as reported by Bluesky.

listUri.description: AT-URI of the backing list. Use with bsky_get_list or bsky_get_feed.

name.description: Name supplied by the starter pack creator.

uri.description: Starter pack AT-URI. Use with bsky_get_list.

truncated.description: True when Bluesky supplied a nonempty continuation cursor.
